Colourway shots are stand-ins until the real ones land.
Add to bag as they are
Message me on WhatsApp — I'm an optician, and I'm happy to help.
Genuine and boxed with the brand's own case, cloth and two-year guarantee.
Free UK delivery over £75, or collect in Birmingham and I'll adjust them to fit while you wait.
Adjustments, tightening and re-fitting are free for as long as you own them.

The Ray-Ban Aviator Classic, in Gold / Green G-15. The pilot shape is about as universally flattering as eyewear gets — the teardrop softens a square jaw and adds length to a rounder face. This size measures 58mm across each lens, which is on the wider side. The lenses block 100% of UV as the brand supplies them, and I can swap in polarised if you would rather. Prescription lenses go in this frame without any trouble — single vision or varifocal — and I cut and fit them here.
Boxed with the brand's own case, cloth and two-year manufacturer's warranty — claims handled by me, not a call centre
Prescription lenses available in this frame — single vision or varifocal
